stories.title: Connelly breaks down a loaded Week 7: Notre Dame-BYU, Ohio State-Indiana and more
stories.summary: The Irish face their first test in the biggest college football game at Provo in ages, but that's just the tip of the iceberg.

stories.title: Ravens rule out QB Jackson;; Huntley to start against Browns
stories.summary: The Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out for a second straight week, elevating Tyler Huntley to the starting role for Sunday's game in Cleveland.

stories.title: Spanish team challenging Thunder rookie Mara's NBA eligibility
stories.summary: A Spanish basketball team is challenging Thunder rookie Aday Mara's eligibility to play in the NBA this season, saying he is still under contract with the club.

stories.title: Browns WR Concepcion clears concussion protocol, will play vs. Ravens
stories.summary: Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion has cleared concussion protocol and will play in Sunday's home game against the Ravens.

stories.title: NCAA sues Ohio gov. over order allowing schools to ignore new eligibility rule
stories.summary: The NCAA has filed a federal lawsuit against Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine three days after he signed an executive order giving the state's colleges and universities the option of allowing athletes who graduated from high school in 2022 to play a fifth year.
